method: Declared local normal/build manifest-edge comparison plus bounded source-diff review; additive reconciliation of graph.json, not full source re-extraction.
review: mvm-crypto depends only on the existing third-party aes-gcm crate; core's at-rest/session wrappers call it. Key custody and protocol state stay with callers.
Runner start/standby/claim and broker-registration definitions move between files within runtime ownership; this does not add a role dependency direction.
BDD now gates its Cucumber dependency with bdd; required-feature coverage remains necessary.
Upstream suspended the Rust footprint ratchet. This design review does not restore it or treat a measurement-only pass as enforcement.
limits: The base source-inventory fingerprint still describes the base revision, not the head.
The delta is not compiler resolution, behavior validation, or authorization to implement.
Only the recorded additive local dependency and unchanged ownership of the reviewed runner split are reconciled; no full source scanner was rerun.
Current closure measurements are retained separately in closure-baseline.json.
